title: trichilia echinocarpa
intro: Trichilia echinocarpa, commonly known as the Chittagong bullet tree, is a plant species in the family Meliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Trichilia echinocarpa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
